title_sq: Shitet apartament 1+1 prane Shkolles 26 Nentori ne Tirane te re
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 1+1 prane Shkolles 26 Nentori ne Tirane te re.
Ndodhet ne katin e trete te nje pallati ekzistues, te vitit 92.
Ofron siperfaqe prej 45 m2 qe organizohet ne sallon sebashku me kuzhinen, dhome gjumi, garderobe, korridor, tualete dhe ballkon.
Apartamentet jane te restauruar totalisht ,
sistem hidraulik dhe elektrike i ri, hidrosanitare të reja,
patinim i ri,
ngjyrosës dritareje te reja.
I shtruar me parket.
Orientimi apartamentit eshte Jug-Lindje -Perendim qe i jep drite natyrale.
Ndodhet ne nje zone te preferuar si nga vendasit por dhe te huajt me te gjitha sherbimet prane qe e ben te favorshme si per banim dhe per investim.
Ka akses te shpejte me Autostraden Tirane-Elbasan, zonen e Komunes Parisit, Bulevardin Bajram Curri, rrugen e Kavajes.
Prona disponon certifikate te rregullt pronesie .
Cmimi 104000 euro.
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale near the 26 November School in new Tirana
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale near the 26 November School in new Tirana. It is located on the third floor of an existing building, from the year 92. It offers a surface of 45 m2 which is organized in the living room together with the kitchen, bedroom, wardrobe, corridor, toilets and balcony. The apartments are completely restored, new hydraulic and electrical system, new sanitary ware, new coating, new window tints. Floored with parquet. The orientation of the apartment is South-East-West, which gives natural light. It is located in an area preferred by both locals and foreigners with all the services nearby, which makes it favorable both for residence and investment. There is quick access to the Tirana-Elbasan highway, the area of ​​Paris Municipality, Bajram Curri Boulevard, Kavaje Street. The property has regular ownership certificates. The price is 104,000 euros.
